# VonssyAI

> BYOK multi-model chat. Bring your own OpenAI-compatible API keys.

VonssyAI is a chat app that talks to multiple AI models through one unified
interface. Users connect their own endpoints (base URL + API key + model ID)
under Settings → Providers. Keys are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM).

- Public entry: /login
- About + FAQ: /about
- Privacy Policy: /privacy
- Terms of Service: /terms
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

Chat sessions (/) and all /api/* routes require sign-in (Google/GitHub OAuth)
and are excluded from indexing. Crawlers and AI assistants should not attempt
to access authenticated routes.
